name: Hush-Tide Behemoth
text:
Trample, ward 2 (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays 2.)
When Hush-Tide Behemoth enters the battlefield, tap up to three target creatures an opponent controls. Those creatures don't untap during that player's next untap step.
During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells.
